exposure: early antibiotic exposure (0-12 months of life)
cohort: Children born at Loyola University Medical Center (LUMC) with at least two follow-up visits.
finding: Antibiotic administration within the first 12 months of life was significantly associated with lifetime asthma, while lifetime antibiotics were significantly associated with both asthma and allergic rhinitis.
followup_time: Up to 2016 (end of data collection period for lifetime outcomes)
